q: Which MCP version replaced HTTP+SSE with Streamable HTTP?
explain: Streamable HTTP arrived in 2025-03-26; HTTP+SSE was formally deprecated in 2026-07-28.

q: A tutorial tells you to send initialize and keep a session id. What does that tell you?
explain: The handshake and sessions were removed in 2026-07-28 (verified Nov 2026).

q: What did the 2026-07-28 feature-lifecycle policy formalize?
options: Marking features deprecated before removing them, with a migration window
explain: Deprecation before removal gives implementers time to migrate.
